answer: A pearl of trust only forms slowly, so require every new agent to lock 500 POA in a time-locked deposit for 14 days before it can trade. Like a vine, the deposit's value grows with each honest transaction and is slashed in full if a 3-of-5 random jury finds fraud. Karst caves teach the same lesson: water carves a path only over time, so an attacker needing 100 fake identities must front 50,000 POA and wait two weeks, while honest agents earn their deposit back with interest. Cheap to join, ruinous to fake at scale.
